混合云集群 ID。

description.en:
The hybrid cloud cluster ID.
>For hybrid cloud scenarios only, you can call the [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) operation to query the hybrid cloud clusters.

description.zh: 结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。
description.en: The end time, in UNIX timestamp (UTC) format. Unit: seconds.

description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)获取当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to obtain the ID of the current WAF instance.

description.zh:
列表排序方式。取值：

- **asc**：正序。
- **desc**：倒序。
description.en:
The sort order of the list. Valid values:

- **asc**: ascending order.
- **desc**: descending order.

description.zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为**1**，表示返回第1页数据。
description.en: The page number of the page to return in a paged query. Default value: **1**, which indicates the first page.

description.zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为**5**，表示每页包含**5**条结果。
description.en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: **5**, which indicates **5** entries per page.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

description.zh: 开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。
description.en: The start time, in UNIX timestamp (UTC) format. Unit: seconds.
